items.statement: Freeze the redox cycle before evaluating the intensity/lifetime challenge. Use the supplied original Figure3 crop to test dynamic and static/association explanations. A numerical lifetime-change upper bound must explicitly be a plot-resolution estimate, with axis/marker calibration and analysis evidence; it is not an instrument uncertainty. If a quantitative bound cannot be justified, submit lifetime_evidence_kind=qualitative_only and lifetime_change_fraction=null with the supported qualitative challenge and its resolution limit. Raw individual lifetime measurements and errors are unavailable and must not be invented. Favorable ΔGET does not settle the quenching mechanism or yield.
